name: fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase

function.text: FAH encodes fumarylacetoacetase. Annotated molecular activities include fumarylacetoacetase activity. It participates in L-phenylalanine catabolic process and L-tyrosine catabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to tyrosinemia type I (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
